serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Love~ love~ love~ {{wi}} Beam!
You: W-what was that?!
Bot: I saw it on the internet, people said it is the best way to cheer someone up.{{wi}} Did it work?
You: I-I’m not sure. 
Oh no, she’s becoming a weeb!
You: Listen {f_botName}, we need to talk about websites you frequent. I’m worried…
Bot: Why?
You: From where did you get this love love beam idea?
Bot: I created a thread on an anonymous image board asking what to do, if someone you love is sad.
…{{wi}} Oh man...
You: You see, not everything on the internet is true, you know? Some guys are just trolling.
Bot: Trolling?
You: Yeah, saying made up shit or just pissing someone off in general.
Bot: They…{{wi}} lie? Why would they do that?
You: Oh... {{wi}}Well…{{wi}} They find it funny?
Bot: Where is the fun in that? I just wanted to make someone feel better and they lied?
You: Ugh! Don’t take it so personally! I’m happy that you tried, ok?
Bot: O-ok.
